title: Add tiled-journey step-resume playbook with synthetic corpora and webhook proxy
author: Amina Patel
description: Motivation: Authoring complex RAG journeys reliably in prod requires deterministic resume/retry semantics, compact telemetry hooks, and tooling to replay partial sessions for debugging. This PR introduces a new quickstart "tiled-journey" that demonstrates stepwise resume semantics (checkpointing at tool-call boundaries), a lightweight webhook proxy for deterministic external call mocking, and a synthetic corpora generator to seed reproducible retrieval scenarios. Summary of changes: added tiled-journey playbook files and walkthrough, a Node-based webhook-proxy sample (with Docker dev container), synthetic-corpora generator script and seed dataset, telemetry scaffolding showing step-level traces and token-level cost summaries, and docs site updates under /quickstarts/tiled-journey. Checklist: [x] Quickstart walkthrough draft written and reviewed; [x] telemetry probe hooks implemented and smoke-tested; [x] webhook proxy basic integration tests; [x] reproducible synthetic corpora generation validated. How to run locally: 1) bootstrap with the provided devcontainer or run "npm run dev:proxy" to start the webhook proxy; 2) index the sample corpus via the quickstart script; 3) run the playbook runner (ts-node) which will walk the tiled journey and demonstrate step-resume by simulating an injected failure at step 3 then resuming from last checkpoint. Testing and CI: added unit tests for the proxy adapter and an end-to-end smoke test that runs in headless mode against a mocked Redwood API. CI matrix includes node 18/20, lint, unit, e2e-smoke and docs-build; all checks passed after fixups. Rollout: feature is non-breaking and lives entirely in quickstarts; docs link added to the quickstarts index and a short announcement will be included in the next docs release notes. Related: draws inspiration from ENG-9367 (stepwise debugging prototype) and complements existing authoring playbooks by focusing on resumability and deterministic external I/O. Notes for reviewers: focus on the telemetry contract shape, the proxy's replay determinism, and the playbook's step checkpoint semantics. Backcompat: none required for core runtime; adapters are opt-in samples.

release_notes: Add tiled-journey quickstart demonstrating step-resume semantics, a webhook proxy sample for deterministic external call mocking, and a synthetic corpora generator for reproducible retrieval tests. Non-breaking, docs-only quickstart addition.
testing_notes: Included e2e smoke test runs in CI. Local dev: use devcontainer or npm scripts. To test resume, run with TEST_INJECT_FAILURE_STEP=3 and then rerun without the flag to confirm resume semantics.
compatibility_notes: Quickstart uses public SDKs and the sample proxy; there are no changes to runtime or API contracts. Consumers can adopt step-resume patterns without platform changes.
notes_for_release: Link added to quickstarts index and docs release; recommend highlighting step-resume demo in next community digest.
